title: Continuous transformations of probability measures and their transport representations
summary: Given a function $F$ transforming a probability measure $μ$ into another one $F(μ)$, we study the existence and regularity of a transport representation of it. That is, we ask whether we can represent the image $F(μ)$ of the input probability measure $μ$ as the push-forward of $μ$ by a map $f(\cdot,μ)$ which may depend on $μ$; and furthermore, how regular $f$ can be chosen depending on $F$.
